## About this vignette

The aim of this vignette is to provide users with a rough estimation of computing times for simulation models included in package **medfateland**.

```{r, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
medfate_ver <- packageVersion("medfate")
```



```{r, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(medfateland)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
data("example_watershed")
numDays <- 30
```


The results presented here were obtained using **`r numDays` days of simulation** with the **example watershed** (`r nrow(medfateland::example_watershed)` grid cells) on a laptop (32 GiB memory and Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 185H × 22) with Ubuntu Linux OS 26.04.1 LTS. 

Both `spwb()` and `growth()` simulation functions are tested. Combinations of submodel choices are tested for the bulk soil water movement (`single` or `dual`), the transpiration model (`Granier` or `Sureau`) and rhizosphereOverlap (`total` or `partial`). Different inputs are tested, depending on forest complexity: original forest inventory (most detailed); trees and shrubs aggregated to size classes; or simplifying the tree and shrub layers to their dominant species.

```{r, echo = FALSE, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE}
file_out <- paste0("computing_times/ct_", medfate_ver, ".csv")
if(!file.exists(file_out)) {

  data("examplemeteo")
  data("SpParamsMED")
  # Set simulation period
  dates <- seq(as.Date("2001-01-01"), as.Date("2001-12-31"), by="day")[1:numDays]
  # Watershed control parameters (TETIS model; Frances et al. 2007)
  ws_control <- default_watershed_control("tetis")
  
  # Set crop factor 
  example_watershed$crop_factor <- as.numeric(NA)
  example_watershed$crop_factor[example_watershed$land_cover_type=="agriculture"] <- 0.75
  # Get bounding box to determine limits
  b <- sf::st_bbox(example_watershed)
  # Define a raster topology, using terra package, 
  # with the same CRS as the watershed. In this example cells have 100 m side.
  # Coordinates in the 'sf' object are assumed to be cell centers
  r <-terra::rast(xmin = 401380, ymin = 4671820, xmax = 402880, ymax = 4672620, 
                nrow = 8, ncol = 15, crs = "epsg:32631")
  # Simplification
  sf_input_detailed <- example_watershed
  sf_input_classes <- sf_input_detailed
  for(i in 1:nrow(sf_input_classes)) {
    f_i <- sf_input_classes$forest[[i]]
    if(!is.null(f_i)) {
      sf_input_classes$forest[[i]] <- medfate::forest_mergeShrubs(medfate::forest_mergeTrees(f_i))
    }
  }
  sf_input_simplified <- sf_input_detailed
  for(i in 1:nrow(sf_input_simplified)) {
    f_i <- sf_input_simplified$forest[[i]]
    if(!is.null(f_i)) {
      sf_input_simplified$forest[[i]] <- medfate::forest_reduceToDominant(f_i, SpParamsMED)
    }
  }
  
  # Warm-up
  example_init <- initialize_landscape(example_watershed, SpParams = SpParamsMED,
                                       local_control = defaultControl(soilDomains = "single", rhizosphereOverlap = "total"), progress = FALSE)
  warmed <- spwb_land(r, example_init, SpParamsMED, examplemeteo, 
                    watershed_control = ws_control, progress = FALSE)

  sf_input_detailed <- medfateland::update_landscape(sf_input_detailed, warmed, columns = c("soil", "aquifer", "snowpack", "outlet_backlog"))
  sf_input_classes <- medfateland::update_landscape(sf_input_classes, warmed, columns = c("soil", "aquifer", "snowpack", "outlet_backlog"))
  sf_input_simplified <- medfateland::update_landscape(sf_input_simplified, warmed, columns = c("soil", "aquifer", "snowpack", "outlet_backlog"))



  df_res_spwb_granier_total <- data.frame(model = "spwb",
                            transpirationMode = c(rep("Granier", 6)),
                            soilDomains = rep(c("single", "dual"),3),
                            rhizosphereOverlap  = "total",
                            input = c(rep("dominant species",2), rep("size classes", 2), rep("original inventory",2)),
                            days = numDays,
                            Elapsed_time_sec = NA)
  df_res_spwb_granier_partial <- df_res_spwb_granier_total
  df_res_spwb_granier_partial$rhizosphereOverlap <- "partial"
  df_res_spwb_granier <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_res_spwb_granier_total, df_res_spwb_granier_partial)
  df_res_spwb_sureau <- df_res_spwb_granier
  df_res_spwb_sureau$transpirationMode <- "Sureau"
  df_res_spwb <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_res_spwb_granier, df_res_spwb_sureau)
  df_res_growth <- df_res_spwb
  df_res_growth$model = "growth"
  
  #spwb
  for(i in 1:nrow(df_res_spwb)) {
    control <- defaultControl(df_res_spwb$transpirationMode[i], df_res_spwb$soilDomains[i], rhizosphereOverlap = df_res_spwb$rhizosphereOverlap[i])
    control$verbose <- FALSE
    if(df_res_spwb$input[i]=="original inventory") {
      sf_init <- medfateland::initialize_landscape(sf_input_detailed, SpParams = medfate::SpParamsMED, model = "spwb", local_control = control, progress = FALSE)
    } else if(df_res_growth$input[i]=="size classes") {
      sf_init <- medfateland::initialize_landscape(sf_input_classes, SpParams = medfate::SpParamsMED, model = "spwb", local_control = control, progress = FALSE)
    } else {
      sf_init <- medfateland::initialize_landscape(sf_input_simplified, SpParams = medfate::SpParamsMED, model = "spwb", local_control = control, progress = FALSE)
    }
    st <- system.time({spwb_land(r, sf_init, SpParamsMED, examplemeteo, 
                       dates = dates, summary_frequency = "month",
                       watershed_control = ws_control, local_control = control, 
                       progress = FALSE)})
    df_res_spwb$Elapsed_time_sec[i] <- st[[3]]
    # print(df_res_spwb[i, ])
  }
  #growth
  for(i in 1:nrow(df_res_growth)) {
    control <- defaultControl(df_res_growth$transpirationMode[i], df_res_growth$soilDomains[i], rhizosphereOverlap = df_res_growth$rhizosphereOverlap[i])
    control$verbose <- FALSE
    if(df_res_growth$input[i]=="original inventory") {
      sf_init <- medfateland::initialize_landscape(sf_input_detailed, SpParams = medfate::SpParamsMED, model = "growth", local_control = control, progress = FALSE)
    } else if(df_res_growth$input[i]=="size classes") {
      sf_init <- medfateland::initialize_landscape(sf_input_classes, SpParams = medfate::SpParamsMED, model = "growth", local_control = control, progress = FALSE)
    } else {
      sf_init <- medfateland::initialize_landscape(sf_input_simplified, SpParams = medfate::SpParamsMED, model = "growth", local_control = control, progress = FALSE)
    }
    st <- system.time({growth_land(r, sf_init, SpParamsMED, examplemeteo, 
                       dates = dates, summary_frequency = "month",
                       watershed_control = ws_control, local_control = control, 
                       progress = FALSE)})
    df_res_growth$Elapsed_time_sec[i] <- st[[3]]
    # print(df_res_growth[i, ])
  }
  df_res <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_res_spwb, df_res_growth)
  names(df_res)[7] <- as.character(medfate_ver)
  write.csv2(df_res, file = file_out, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Table of computational times

Computational times were estimated using `system.time()`, are in **seconds** and are shown by **medfate** package version.

```{r, echo = FALSE}
files <- list.files("computing_times/", full.names = TRUE)
df_res <- NULL
for(i in 1:length(files)) {
  df_res_i <- read.csv2(files[i])
  if(!("rhizosphereOverlap" %in% names(df_res_i))) {
    df_res_i <- df_res_i |>
      dplyr::mutate(rhizosphereOverlap = "total") |>
      dplyr::relocate("rhizosphereOverlap", .before = soilDomains)
  }
  names(df_res_i)[5] <- substr(names(df_res_i)[5], 2, nchar(names(df_res_i)[5]))
  if(is.null(df_res)) {
    df_res <- df_res_i
  } else {
    df_res <- df_res |>
      dplyr::left_join(df_res_i, by = c("model", "transpirationMode", "rhizosphereOverlap", "soilDomains"))
  }
}
df_res |>
  dplyr::rename("function" = "model") |>
  kbl() |>
  kable_styling()
```
